items.title: 4.2.2 Queue: Best for FIFO Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a queue (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Kab istemal karein: jahan kaam 'First-In, First-Out' (FIFO) tarteeb mein karne hon, wahan queue behtareen hai. Yaani queue mein pehle dala gaya element pehle nikalta hai. Queues aam taur par yahan istemal hoti hain:

items: Breadth-First Search (BFS): graphs ya trees mein, jahan agle level se pehle maujooda level ke saare nodes dekhe jate hain.
Task scheduling: jahan kaam aane ki tarteeb se kiye jate hain, jaise print jobs sambhalna ya web server par aane wali requests.
Asal zindagi ki simulation (naqal): jaise dukaan mein gahakon ki line ka model banana.

blocks.prompt: Web server ko bohat se users ki requests milti hain. Kaunsa structure inhein insaf se sambhalta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Queue, kyunke requests aane ki tarteeb se poori hoti hain (FIFO).

items: Queue: aane ki tarteeb (FIFO) wale kaam: BFS, scheduling, line ki simulation.
